test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Unemployment has __become a fiery question__ of the day.
solution:
The correct answer is **'become a burning question'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'fiery'** means consisting of fire.

 
 
• **Example-** The helicopter crashed in a **fiery** explosion.
 
 
 
• **Burning question** is a **collocation **that means** something that people have strong opinions about and think is very important.**
 
 
• **Example:** The **burning question** is: can the Internet be regulated?
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Unemployment has __**become a burning question**__ of the day.*

**__Additional Information__**

 
• The word **'fiery'** is also used to mean someone having a passionate or quick-tempered nature.

 
 
• Example- She is a **fiery** imaginative Aries.
